method: For each sampled native transverse plane and each declared Allen source structure, select exact annotation values by frozen terminology identifier path (or exact identifier for Central Canal), split the binary source mask with deterministic 4-neighbour connectivity, and trace closed polygons on the exact pixel edges of every component. No components, bilateral masks, planes, or source structures are bridged, interpolated, or hand drawn.
